Hello Rizzi Luca﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product

ChargerID/Serial No.
:
jQVpnB
Problem Description
:
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
Troubleshooting
:
We will recommend you the following steps to be followed
1. Check resistance between P1 and P2, N1 and N2 in below attached image, and check at the XD101.
2. Connectivity between P2 & N2.
3. Interchange the wiring of DC1 & DC2 cable to check from where the issue is generating.
4. Please check the KF13 wirings.
If all values are normal then try to swap the sensor wirings of DC1 and DC2 output cables going into KF13/KF14.
Temp V/s Resistance Table -
Additionally, please bring a spare cable for the site visit and replace it if necessary.
MLFB No.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0376663
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
